title: ExtractionCandidate
description: A complete candidate envelope: the model's semantic payload wrapped with pipeline-generated identity, document reference, producer metadata, and timestamps. Candidates are never facts; they await deterministic validation and human review before any promotion.

candidate_id.description: UUID v4 identifying this candidate. Generated by the pipeline, NEVER by the model.

document_id.description: ID of the stored raw document this candidate was extracted from. Must reference an existing row in the immutable raw_documents table (FK added in migration 003).

candidate_sha256.description: Deterministic semantic idempotency fingerprint: sha256(document_id + request_sha256 + canonical JSON of the semantic fields, excluding confidence). Generated by the pipeline, NEVER by the model. Enforced UNIQUE in the database (migration 004).

subject.description: The entity or concept the claim is about. E.g. 'Spanish electricity market', 'RDL 10/2022'.

predicate.description: The relationship or property being asserted. E.g. 'has_average_price', 'was_published_on', 'sets_cap_at'.

value.description: The asserted value as stated in the document. May be null when the document explicitly states the value is unknown or not applicable.

value_raw.description: The exact text from the document that states the value, before any normalization.

unit_raw.description: The unit as written in the document, before normalization.

unit_canonical.description: The canonical unit after normalization, if deterministically mappable.

definition.description: Optional clarification of what the subject/predicate/value combination means, especially when the document defines a term.

geography.description: Geographic scope of the claim. E.g. 'Spain', 'Iberian Peninsula', 'EU'. Null when not applicable.

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 date when the claim became valid in the world. Null when the document does not specify.

valid_to.description: ISO 8601 date when the claim ceased to be valid. Null when open-ended or unspecified.

source_spans.description: TRUSTED, PIPELINE-DERIVED character ranges in the source document that support this claim. Derived deterministically by anchoring the model's untrusted evidence_quotes in raw_text (exact match, exactly-once). Model-supplied numeric offsets never enter this field. Invariant: raw_text.slice(start, end) === text for every span. At least one span is required.

start.description: Zero-based character offset of the span start in the document text.

end.description: Zero-based character offset of the span end (exclusive) in the document text.

text.description: The exact text at [start, end) in the source document. Used for verification.

confidence.description: Model self-assessed confidence in this extraction, 0.0 to 1.0.

model_name.description: Name of the model that produced this candidate. Generated by the pipeline from the API response.

model_version.description: Exact model version string from the API response. Generated by the pipeline.

prompt_template_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the reusable extraction prompt template (not including the document text).

request_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the exact expanded request sent to the model, including the document text.

extracted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the extraction was performed. Generated by the pipeline.
